wordProblems.q: Isabella has 9 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 3 more books. How many books does Isabella have now?
Liam has 17 crayons. He loses 2 crayons at school. How many crayons does Liam have left?
Emma picks 17 oranges from a tree. Then Emma picks 2 more oranges. How many oranges did Emma pick in all?
There are 16 ducks in a pond. 9 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Emma makes 12 cupcakes. Her friend brings 2 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Jack has 9 toy cars. He gives 6 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Jack have left?
Leo finds 2 seashells on the beach in the morning and 4 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Leo find in all?
Ruby has 7 flowers in her garden. She picks 3 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
Owen eats 7 grapes at lunch and 8 grapes after school. How many grapes did Owen eat in all?
Nora is reading a book with 13 pages. Nora reads 11 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 11 muffins in the morning and 5 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 11 fish in a tank. The shop sells 6 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Sophia has 3 red beads and 14 blue beads. How many beads does Sophia have in all?
Liam collects 17 toy trains. He lends 2 trains to a friend. How many trains does Liam have left?
Ben has 16 apples in a basket. Ben eats 8 apples. How many apples are left in the basket?
Sara draws 4 stars on Monday and 4 stars on Tuesday. How many stars did Sara draw in all?
A monkey has 16 bananas. It eats 15 bananas. How many bananas does the monkey have left?
Lily has 4 apples. Lily buys 8 more apples. How many apples does Lily have now?
Mason has 12 stickers. Mason gives 7 stickers to Sophia. How many stickers does Mason have left?
Leo has 17 marbles. His friend gives him 3 more marbles. How many marbles does Leo have now?
There are 14 frogs sitting on a log. 5 frogs jump into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Ethan collects 4 smooth rocks at the river and 12 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Ethan collect in all?
Mia has 16 cherries in a bowl. She gives 9 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
17 red buses and 2 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
Leo has 8 pairs of socks in a drawer. Leo takes 1 pair out to wear this week. How many pairs of socks are left in the drawer?
Leo flies 17 kites in the park. His dad brings 2 more kites. How many kites are there now?
Chloe has 19 candies in a jar. She shares 1 candy with her sister. How many candies are left in the jar?
Omar picks 8 lemons from a tree in the morning and 5 lemons in the evening. How many lemons did Omar pick in all?
There are 15 rabbits in a garden. 12 rabbits hop away. How many rabbits are left in the garden?
Ben builds a tower with 8 blocks. Then he adds 3 more blocks on top. How many blocks are in the tower now?
